1401: import java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\npublic class Symmetric {\n    public static void symmetric(int n) {\n        List<Integer> elements = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            elements.add(i);\n        }\n        List<List<Integer>> permutations = new ArrayList<>();\n        generatePermutations(elements, 0, permutations);\n        for (List<Integer> perm : permutations) {\n            Permutation p = new Permutation(perm);\n            System.out.println(p);\n        }\n    }\n    private static void generatePermutations(List<Integer> elements, int start, List<List<Integer>> result) {\n        if (start == elements.size()) {\n            result.add(new ArrayList<>(elements));\n            return;\n        }\n        for (int i = start; i < elements.size(); i++) {\n            swap(elements, start, i);\n            generatePermutations(elements, start + 1, result);\n            swap(elements, start, i);\n        }\n    }\n    private static void swap(List<Integer> elements, int i, int j) {\n        int temp = elements.get(i);\n        elements.set(i, elements.get(j));\n        elements.set(j, temp);\n    }\n    static class Permutation {\n        private List<Integer> data;\n        public Permutation(List<Integer> data) {\n            this.data = new ArrayList<>(data);\n        }\n        @Override\n        public String toString() {\n            return data.toString();\n        }\n    }\n}

2793: public class SpecificityCalculator {\n    public static double specificity(java.util.function.Predicate<String> classify, java.util.List<String> documents) {\n        int[] confusionMatrix = confusionMatrix(classify, documents);\n        int TP = confusionMatrix[0];\n        int TN = confusionMatrix[1];\n        int FP = confusionMatrix[2];\n        int FN = confusionMatrix[3];\n        return (double) TN / ((TN + FP) == 0 ? 1 : (TN + FP));\n    }\n    private static int[] confusionMatrix(java.util.function.Predicate<String> classify, java.util.List<String> documents) {\n        int TP = 0, TN = 0, FP = 0, FN = 0;\n        for (String document : documents) {\n            boolean classified = classify.test(document);\n            if (classified) {\n                if (document.equals("positive")) {\n                    TP++;\n                } else {\n                    FP++;\n                }\n            } else {\n                if (document.equals("positive")) {\n                    FN++;\n                } else {\n                    TN++;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        return new int[]{TP, TN, FP, FN};\n    }\n}

3874: public double crossEntropy(double[] input, double[] target, double[] weight, boolean sizeAverage) {\n    double[] logSoftmax = logSoftmax(input);\n    return nllLoss(logSoftmax, target, weight, sizeAverage);\n}\nprivate double[] logSoftmax(double[] input) {\n    double max = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;\n    for (double val : input) {\n        if (val > max) {\n            max = val;\n        }\n    }\n    double[] result = new double[input.length];\n    double sum = 0.0;\n    for (int i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {\n        result[i] = Math.exp(input[i] - max);\n        sum += result[i];\n    }\n    for (int i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {\n        result[i] = Math.log(result[i] / sum);\n    }\n    return result;\n}\nprivate double nllLoss(double[] logSoftmax, double[] target, double[] weight, boolean sizeAverage) {\n    double loss = 0.0;\n    int count = 0;\n    for (int i = 0; i < target.length; i++) {\n        int index = (int) target[i];\n        if (index < 0 || index >= logSoftmax.length) {\n            continue;\n        }\n        double w = 1.0;\n        if (weight != null && weight.length > index) {\n            w = weight[index];\n        }\n        loss += -logSoftmax[index] * w;\n        if (sizeAverage) {\n            count++;\n        }\n    }\n    return sizeAverage ? loss / count : loss;\n}
